name: Closed Minds
overview: Scripture reveals that closed minds result from hearts and ears that are unresponsive to God's truth, as seen in Matthew 13:15 where eyes are deliberately closed to avoid understanding and conversion. Proverbs warns against answering before hearing and using harsh words, which can harden hearts rather than open them (Proverbs 15:1; 18:13). True freedom and life come through knowing and following Jesus, the way and the truth, who alone leads to the Father (John 8:32; John 14:6). The Spirit of truth guides believers into all truth, overcoming closed minds by revealing God's will and future (John 16:13).
